t: You're on Chiswick Mall, a waterfront street on the north bank of the Thames, in the oldest part of Chiswick. On one side, a row of large Georgian and Victorian houses looks over the street. On the other, their gardens run down beside the river and Chiswick Eyot. Henrietta, Lady Grant, died here in 1896. She was the wife of Sir John Peter Grant, and she is one of the many residents who have lived along this stretch of river.
